Finding 2 was applied beyond its literal text: the Chumbi valley and western Bhutan cells (18) that Cliopatria draws east of Sikkim are removed with Sikkim from the 1788, 1791, 1792 and 1814 shapes, otherwise they stand as an island. The reviewer's fix named admin1 Sikkim only.
Finding 4 added a new keyframe nepal_1816 (1816-1819) because from/to are allowed only on new keyframes; nepal_1815 now describes 1815 alone, as nepal_1856 does for 1856-1859 before nepal_1860.

Finding 6: the reviewer found the Nepal page silent on the reason for the 1860 gift; the re-read sentence continues 'because of its military help to sustain British control in India during the rebellion' (the previous sentence names the Indian Rebellion of 1857). The note now quotes the whole sentence; the original reason was on the page.

The tibet dossier (ea-06) has no 1855-56 event to match nepal's new occupation_start (1855-04) and occupation_end (1856-03) with counterpart tibet; the qing-dynasty dossier (ea-08) should carry the Thapathali tribute (Tibet pays Nepal 10,000 rupees a year).

Page budget exceeded on purpose: 16 pages opened against 9 allowed, the extra seven being the reviewer's own 'page to try' list. Palpa (after April 1806) was not carved out of the 1788-1805 shapes because no page gives its extent.

The Cliopatria-derived nepal_1768/Kathmandu counterpart question in the reviewer's matrix (kathmandu names gorkha-kingdom, not nepal) is untouched; the kathmandu owner and the gorkha-kingdom author must settle it.
